Hey Sara - so unfortunately this may be an uneducated PIBA clerk. There is no longer a requirement to prove that the marriage is registered in the foreigner's home country - it used to be a requirement, but it was abolished in early 2024. If you have submitted a personal status document showing that you are still registered as single in the UK, then they should not be requesting this marriage registration document. You can read about this on our website here: https://aic.org.il/2024-big-updates-to-partner-visa-procedures-5-2-0008-5-2-0009/#:~:text=1%2E%20Marriage%20Registration%20in%20Country%20of%20Origin%20No%20Longer%20A%20Threshold%20Condition

I would suggest replying to the clerk stating that you understand this is no longer a requirement in the procedure.
